desc: Analyze problem and design solution (binary search + DP).
Implement `feasible(L)` DP: state `dp0[i]`/`dp1[i]` = min flips so prefix [0..i] is valid ending in 0/1, with all runs ≤ L.
Integrate binary search over L in [1, n] calling `feasible(L)`, returning smallest L where it's achievable.
Test on examples and random small cases against brute force.
